bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health insurance; requiring providers of outpatient behavioral health services to be paid at least 143 percent of the Medicare rate; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 62Q.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[62Q.138] OUTPATIENT BEHAVIORAL HEALTH SERVICES PAYMENT RATES.

(a) A health plan company shall pay a health care provider at least 143 percent of the Medicare rate as published in the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services annual final rule updating payments and policies for outpatient behavioral health services. Outpatient behavioral health services include but are not limited to outpatient substance use disorder and mental health treatment.

(b) This section does not apply to coverage provided to state public health care program enrollees under chapter 256B or 256L.
